newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Ireland's Telecom signs strategic alliance accord.
newsitem.headline: Ireland's Telecom signs strategic alliance accord.

text.p: A strategic alliance between state-owned Irish telecommunications company Telecom Eireann and an international consortium made up of PTT Telecom BV of the Netherlands and Telia AB of Sweden was concluded on Friday with the signing of final agreements, the Irish government said.
PTT and Telia have acquired a 20 percent interest in Telecom Eireann with an option to purchase an additional 15 percent stake after three years.
Earlier today, the European Commission cleared the joint venture on competition grounds, saying the concentration did not result in a direct change in market shares.
